title: Claude launches interactive carousel design inside #claudeai #interactivevisuals #designautomation
description: Claude introduced an update that enables designing interactive visuals directly within chats, rivaling Canva’s capabilities. Using a specific prompt, Claude can generate a polished Instagram carousel complete with progress bars, page counters, and cohesive color palettes in just minutes. This feature simplifies the content creation process by combining design and AI chat, reducing the need for external graphic tools. It highlights a shift towards more integrated creative workflows powered by AI to boost productivity and quality in social media marketing. For creators and marketers, this means faster, cleaner, and highly customizable visual content without leaving the chat interface, streamlining campaigns and engagement efforts. Comment "art" and I'll send you the exact prompt I'm using. #ClaudeAI #AIDesign #InstagramCarousel #ContentCreation #SocialMediaMarketing #CanvaAlternative #InteractiveDesign #AIWorkflow #CreativeAI #DigitalMarketing #VisualContent #AIUpdate #MarketingTools #ProductivityTools #ChatbotDesign
